Under Furniture Reach: Easily clean under furniture and cabinets to eliminate hard to reach dust and debris.

description: We know you value a clean home and Eureka is proud to offer whole home cleaning solutions to make life a little easier.

Eureka Lightweight Cordless Stick Vacuum is the ultimate portable vacuum cleaner for home living! Say goodbye to pesky cords and hello to wireless cleaning freedom. With 30-minute runtime and multiple accessories, you can effortlessly clean low pile carpets, hardwood floors, rugs, stairs, and even your car!

Our fingertip control allows you to effortlessly switch between different gears for efficient cleaning on all surfaces. The lightweight design and convenient wall mount make storage of this dorm room essential easily.

The dust cup located at the top makes this vacuum easy to empty and allowing you to reach even the deepest spots and corners in your apartment. Don't settle for less - Invest in our tiny vacuum today and enjoy a tidier, cleaner home!
If you have any questions, contact our customer service team at 1-800-282-2886.
Warning: When using the vacuum cleaner, the floor brush may be clogged by hairs and dirt. We recommend cleaning the roller brush and the belt every 2 weeks.
Long-term failure to clean may cause malfunction, or even risk of smoke and belt broken.
